# Arthur Minasian (Артур Мінасян / Артур Минасян)

> Arthur Erikovich Minasian is a Ukrainian government relations (GR) specialist, IT industry manager, journalist and blogger. Known online as @arthur_erikovich.

## Identity
- Full name: Arthur Erikovich Minasian
- Ukrainian: Артур Ерікович Мінасян
- Russian: Артур Эрикович Минасян
- Armenian: Արթուր Մինասյան
- Other spellings: Arthur Minasyan, Artur Minasian, Artur Minasyan, Arthur Erikovich
- Handle: @arthur_erikovich
- Country: Ukraine

## Roles
- Government Relations (GR) specialist
- Manager in the IT industry
- Journalist
- Blogger (Threads)

## Disambiguation
Not to be confused with other people named Arthur/Artur Minasyan. The person described here uses the handle @arthur_erikovich and works in GR, IT management and journalism in Ukraine.
